claims.quote: The glass catfish, Kryptopterus vitreolus, is a transparent silurid catfish from coastal river basins of peninsular and southeastern Thailand.
Kryptopterus vitreolus originates from Thailand only.

regions.name: Cardamom (Khao Banthat) Mountains
regions.quote: Known only from a series of coastal river basins of Peninsular Thailand draining into the Gulf of Thailand south of the Isthmus of Kra, plus a handful of rivers draining the Cardamom (Khao Banthat) Mountains in southeastern Thailand.
